title: Activate the CRM Core Slice 1 change-to-evidence pilot under Delivery and TDE
summary: Start the first bounded Delivery / TDE / PXS Tools integration pilot using CRM Core Slice 1 as the proving case. The pilot should route the change-to-evidence support loop into canonical TDE-tracked work without making TDE the primary implementation plane for CRM feature development.

body.summary: Activate the CRM Core Slice 1 change-to-evidence support loop defined in the pilot note and pilot contract. The immediate objective is to move one real CRM Slice 1 cycle through explicit kickoff, verification capture, evidence assembly, and completion-or-abort review using TDE-backed machine-work state and a Delivery-governed evidence-completeness gate. The pilot must preserve the agreed boundary: CRM implementation remains owned by PXS Tools and the implementation lane, while TDE owns the execution-support state around the cycle.
expected_closure_evidence: explicit kickoff packet or equivalent activation record for CRM Core Slice 1 under the pilot contract
one recorded verification/test capture step with explicit pass/fail or mixed-result output
one explicit evidence packet for the slice run containing implementation summary, test summary, out-of-scope confirmation, unresolved issues, and recommended next action
a clear completion, abort, or follow-up-required judgment for the pilot cycle
a visible record that TDE carried the execution-support state rather than chat-memory-only coordination

current_execution_status.current_open_gap: The pilot boundary and contract are now explicit, but no canonical TDE-backed kickoff cycle has yet been activated for CRM Core Slice 1. Without that activation, the integration remains designed but unproven.
current_execution_status.next_authorized_step: Create the first bounded kickoff packet for CRM Core Slice 1 under the pilot contract, then move the cycle through verification capture and evidence assembly using the defined TDE-owned support states and Delivery evidence-completeness gate.

proposed_action: Create canonical tracked work for the first CRM change-to-evidence pilot cycle and use it as the proving case for Delivery/TDE/PXS Tools integration.
requested_action: Do not leave the CRM pilot as an architecture note only; activate one real bounded cycle through TDE-backed execution-support state with Delivery-governed evidence expectations.
success_signal: One real CRM Core Slice 1 pilot cycle runs through explicit kickoff, verification capture, evidence assembly, and completion/abort review under the agreed boundary.
